question: None shared. P-274's AUC is prognostic: four-year progression from SCD/MCI to AD dementia in 332 memory-clinic patients from BioFINDER-1, with clinical data plus hippocampal volume. P-33's AUC is diagnostic: a Bayesian-KDE classifier assigns current clinical status (cognitively unimpaired vs MCI) at each visit from a disease-progression score fitted to neuropsychological scores, in ADNI. P-33 excluded every MCI participant who progressed to dementia, so its data contain no instance of P-274's outcome. Its only prognostic analysis concerns CU-to-MCI conversion. The clinical/cognitive channel is shared (P-274's clinical-data model; P-33's neuropsychological scores), but the task and comparison are not.
metric: ROC-AUC in both, for different endpoints: future AD dementia within four years against present CU/MCI status per visit.

figures.P-274: Clinical data + intracranial and hippocampal volume: test AUC 0.862 (printed CI 0.728-0.960). Clinical data only: 0.850 (CI 0.698-0.954). BioFINDER-1, 332 SCD/MCI patients, 109 progressors.
figures.P-33: Leaspy, Bayesian-KDE CU-vs-MCI status classifier on the 20% test split: top AUC 0.96 (SD 0.006 across bootstrapped models). ADNI cohort of 536 sCU, 114 pCU and 513 sMCI. With the bootstrap SD as the spread: 0.96 +- 1.96*0.006 = [0.948, 0.972].

matched_figure_check: No matched figure exists. P-33 reports no MCI-to-dementia prediction; such participants were excluded. P-274 reports no CU-vs-MCI classification; its population is all SCD/MCI. As arithmetic only: P-33's 0.96 sits on P-274's printed upper bound (0.960), not outside it, while P-274's 0.862 lies outside P-33's bootstrap interval [0.948, 0.972]. That one-way separation compares two different estimands and carries no weight.
performance_validity: The exclusion does not apply. P-274's 0.862 is below 0.97. P-33's 0.96 is below 0.97, from a held-out 20% split of a cohort of more than 1,100 participants. Not a performance comparison on a shared task in any case. Checked against P-274 page 6 and P-33 pages 2, 4 and 6.
reason: The two AUCs measure different things: a four-year SCD/MCI-to-AD-dementia prognosis in BioFINDER against a per-visit CU-vs-MCI status classification in ADNI. P-33 deliberately excludes MCI patients who progressed to dementia, so it cannot speak to P-274's question. Condition 1 fails. The ledger's 'T2' label for P-33's figure is a misreading of a diagnostic AUC as a progression AUC.

quotes.quote: The primary binary outcome was four-year progression to AD dementia, where a clinical diagnosis of AD dementia during the four years follow-up was considered as a progression.
The clinical data model consisting of demographics (age, sex, and education), MMSE score, ADAS delayed word recall and APOE status had a mean BioFINDER test AUC of 0.850 (CI 0.698–0.954)
Adding intracranial and hippocampal volume to the clinical data model increased the test AUC to 0.862 (CI 0.728–0.960)

Additionally, MCI participants whose last visit indicated either reversion to CU or progression to dementia were excluded from the analysis to specifically characterize the transition from normal cognition to MCI.
Area Under the Curve (AUC) of the Bayesian-KDE classifier at each visit, based on clinical diagnoses.
The results show that Leaspy achieved the highest overall performance, with a top AUC of 0.96
